## Fixed

- Wallpaper crop exports now copy an integer-aligned source rectangle at exactly 1:1 resolution. Fractional crop coordinates no longer blend neighboring pixels or soften fine detail. PNG export remains lossless, with no resizing or upscaling.
- Verified exported pixels against the decoded source for WebP, 4K, zoomed, small, and Settings crops. The existing 10 MB limit remains.

## Refresh an existing wallpaper

Choose **Crop & zoom** to create a fresh crop from the saved original source, then **Save Wallpapers**. If the original source is unavailable, choose your original image file again. Previously exported images cannot recover detail already lost.

## Windows antivirus warning

Windows may flag Hotori as a Trojan and quarantine or remove hotori.exe. We believe this is a false positive, but Microsoft has not confirmed it. Check the affected file in Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Protection history. Only after verifying its source and deciding it is safe, choose Restore or Allow on device for that specific file. Recovery instructions are available in the repository’s docs/installation-guide.md even if the app cannot open.

- Wallpaper crops preserve the selected source resolution without upscaling, instead of being limited to 1920 pixels or 2,073,600 pixels total. Fractional crop edges round down to whole pixels.

## Windows antivirus warning

Windows may flag Hotori as a Trojan and quarantine or remove hotori.exe. We believe this is a false positive; Microsoft has not confirmed that assessment. A local build has been affected; we have not established which published releases are affected.

If Hotori disappears, open **Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Protection history** and check whether the affected file is your Hotori download. Only if you have verified its source and are satisfied it is safe, expand that specific detection and choose **Actions → Restore** or **Allow on device**, whichever Windows offers. Download hotori.exe again from this repository's Releases page if the file was removed. Do not disable antivirus protection or exclude an entire folder.

If you are unsure, leave the file quarantined and report the detection name and app version in a GitHub issue. Recovery instructions are also available in [the online guide](https://github.com/tsukidan/hotori/blob/main/docs/installation-guide.md), even when the app cannot open.

## macOS (Apple Silicon)

Download **Hotori_1.7.3_macOS_Apple_Silicon_AutoUpdate.dmg**, open it, and drag Hotori into Applications.

- Install, remove, and customize Hotori for Vencord.
- Uses lighter glass rendering for macOS responsiveness.
- Requires macOS 11 or newer and Vencord for Discord.
- Fully quit Discord with **Command-Q** before clicking **Install**, then reopen Discord.
- **Signed Mac app updates are now supported:** choose **Update Hotori → Download & restart** when a newer Mac version is published. Downloads are verified before the app bundle is replaced and Hotori restarts.
- **One-time upgrade:** users of the original Mac build must quit Hotori and replace it using the AutoUpdate DMG once. Future Mac updates use the in-app updater.
- Theme settings and wallpapers are retained. Theme updates continue working inside Hotori.
- The `.app.tar.gz`, `.sig`, and `hotori-macos-update.json` assets support Mac auto-updates; you do not need to open them manually.
- The older DMG remains available for reference; use the **AutoUpdate** DMG for new installs.
- Apple Silicon only; Intel Macs are not supported by this download.
- This initial Mac build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized.

## What's new

- Added a liquid glass crop editor for local images, image links, and pasted images. Drag to position and use the slider or mouse wheel to zoom. Main Background crops stay at **16:9**; Settings Background suggests the image's original aspect ratio and offers alternatives.

- Grouped each wallpaper with its own dimming controls.
- Added wallpaper-sampled color recommendations under **Main Color** and under mention settings in **Messages**. Choosing a swatch saves only that color, preserving unrelated drafts and mention opacity. Settings Background is never sampled.
- Added two quick color swatches beside **Clear background**, plus a link to more color controls. Glowing white dots highlight categories with recommendations until you visit them.

Crops are saved locally as still PNG images. Original images and crop positions are retained for later adjustments. Save Wallpapers to apply a cropped background; recommended color swatches save immediately.

Hotori is a Windows installer and customizer for the Hotori Discord theme.

### Get started
1. Install [Vencord](https://vencord.dev/download/).
2. Download **hotori.exe** below and open it.
3. Click **Install**, enable Hotori in **Vencord → Themes**, then use **Customize**.

### Included
- Acrylic and liquid glass appearance options.
- Custom colors, blur, avatars, and server list layout.
- Local wallpaper files or image links.
- Separate category saves and Reset to defaults.
- Theme updates from GitHub that preserve your saved customization settings.

Only the EXE is needed. Theme updates are separate from app releases.
